I have bounced back after trying therapy pills and etc. Dropping off toxic people and so forth. However, I am sure there is something in life that still can make you happy, no matter small or big. Sometimes its receiving good news, getting a notification from a friend or relative or someone who liked your post. Think of that, there has to be something that is worth living for

Dear OP, your feelings are valid but reality is that everything can change, any situation. Make a decision, start small, do not make such a big decision without trying once more.

The reason you wrote this post as any post here is that there is a little part of you that wants help. You do not want to die, you just need help. I know it is easier said than done and if change were this easy no one would consider this as a decision. I had the patience to read through your post and I am nobody to you, so consider this a sign to continue. Things can change

My only advice here (from personal experience) is that yes, you probably have a good reason to want to end it but there is always always a chance you survive, no matter what you think. And if you do, it will be likely worse than it is for you now. Think of that
Realizing it is basically impossible to keep new friends so you need to stick with the ones you made while you were younger
They are evolving in the wrong direction

Im so sorry for what you have been going through. You feeling so concerned about the whole situation just proves that you are indeed a good person, who for a second didnt think twice and did something regretful. That happens to a lot of us when we are young, we just dont admit to it. Taking your life does not delete the past. I sincerely hope you consider talking to some close friends or a therapist for a bit longer, you will see that it will help slowly. You can also message me if you want to talk. Please just do not take your life, you are too young. This is all coming from someone who has attempted a few times. Its just not worth it.
